title: Ultimate World & Science Trivia (20 Questions)
description: A high-energy 20-question Kahoot-style quiz covering world geography, science, tech, history, and pop culture.

questions.text: What is the capital city of Australia?
Which element has the chemical symbol 'Au'?
Who is credited with inventing the World Wide Web in 1989?
What is the largest organ in the human body?
Which planet in our solar system has the most moons?
In computer science, what does 'HTTP' stand for?
How many valves does a standard human heart have?
Which country is home to the ancient monument Machu Picchu?
What programming language was created by Brendan Eich in just 10 days in 1995?
What is the hardest natural substance known on Earth?
Which ocean is the largest and deepest on Earth?
What is the speed of light in a vacuum (approximate)?
Which company originally created the Android mobile operating system before Google acquired it?
In what year did the Apollo 11 mission land the first humans on the Moon?
What is the smallest unit of memory in computing?
Which gas makes up the majority (about 78%) of Earth's atmosphere?
Who painted the famous masterpiece 'The Starry Night'?
What is the boiling point of water in Fahrenheit at sea level?
Which desert is the largest hot desert in the world?
What is the currency of Japan?
